question: Does the current typed ambient-H1 line state add a source direction beyond the occupancy clock and the existing JS column, and is its appearance related to the age-standardized rank-one completion cause?

source.name: W_line
source.definition: At pre-insertion rank k, W_line=1[K1<=k<K2] exp(i 4 arg(P ell)), where ell is the primitive rank-one homology line and P ell is its lifted Euclidean representative; W_line=0 outside the rank-one plateau.
source.clock_control: All connected products are evaluated at the fixed pre-insertion k0, so n_occ is constant within a size/orientation row.
source.old_source_control: JS and its same-batch Gram entries use the existing canonical-site normalization. Column scaling cannot change whether the frozen 2x2 determinant is zero.

observers.rotation: counter-derived common C4 turn per replica and pre-insertion k

primary_source_rank_gate.statistic: complex determinant after the existing across-orientation P4 projection
primary_source_rank_gate.null: the new W_line column lies in the same observer-space source direction as JS
primary_source_rank_gate.decision: within each size, reject the rank-one source lane only when the two-real-component delete-one chi-square exceeds 9.21034037198 (alpha=0.01)
primary_source_rank_gate.sizes: N325 and N425 are separate evidence blocks and are not pooled

secondary.gram: report the same-batch residual norm fraction 1-|<W_line,JS>|^2/(<|W_line|^2><|JS|^2>)
secondary.completion: at k0, decompose mark12_h4 completion into risk-composition and age-standardized conditional-hazard terms using common (ell,age) support across orientations
secondary.joint_covariance: delete one aligned batch from path and sparse streams and publish the full covariance of determinant, Gram residual, risk composition and conditional hazard

stop_rules: do not pool the two sizes or treat them as replicas
do not change k0, radius, matrices, source definition or alpha after reveal
do not interpret a pilot source-rank lift as a CFT field identity
stop without scoring if complement or separated-mark audits fail
